# Teachwire

> Teachwire is a comprehensive UK education platform providing free teaching resources, lesson plans, CPD training, and educational news for primary and secondary schools across all key stages.

Teachwire serves educators with curated teaching materials, curriculum-aligned resources, and professional development content. The platform covers primary education (KS1-KS2) extensively, with dedicated sections for every major subject area, assessment guidance, and specialist topics like SEND and health & wellbeing.

## Key Topics

- KS1 & KS2 Curriculum
- Lesson Plans
- Teaching Resources
- Free Resources
- SATs Preparation
- Primary Education
- Creative Writing
- SEND Support
- Health & Wellbeing
- Educational Technology
- CPD Training
- Assessment
- Cross-curricular Learning
- Teacher Guides
- Early Years (EYFS)

## Core Resources & Archives

- [Teachwire Homepage](https://www.teachwire.net): Teachwire homepage: free teaching resources, CPD, and advice for educators
- [Resources Archive](https://www.teachwire.net/teaching-resources): Central archive of teaching resources across KS1, KS2, KS3 with worksheets and packs
- [Primary Education Hub](https://www.teachwire.net/primary): Primary education hub with KS1 and KS2 teaching materials and lesson plans

## Primary Curriculum by Subject

- [English KS1 & KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/english): KS1 and KS2 English curriculum lesson plans, writing activities, and literature teaching
- [Maths KS1 & KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/maths): KS1 and KS2 maths resources with games, reasoning activities, SATs prep, and worksheets
- [Computing KS1 & KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/computing): Primary computing curriculum with Scratch, micro:bit projects, and coding resources
- [History KS1 & KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/history): KS1 and KS2 history curriculum projects, lesson plans, and ancient/world war topics
- [Geography KS1 & KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/geography): Primary geography lesson plans aligned to KS1 and KS2 curriculum with climate topics
- [Art & Design](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/art-design): KS1 and KS2 Art & Design lesson plans, projects, and creative activities
- [Design & Technology](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/design-technology): KS1 and KS2 Design & Technology lessons, CAD/CAM, textiles, and cross-curricular ideas
- [PE KS1 & KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/pe): KS1 and KS2 PE games, activities, dance, and sports fitness resources
- [Music KS1 & KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/music): Primary music lesson plans, composition, singing activities, and KS1/KS2 curriculum links
- [Languages KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/languages): KS2 modern and ancient language teaching resources for French, Spanish, and Latin

## Specialist Topics & Support

- [Assessment KS1 & KS2](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/assessment): Primary assessment resources including SATs prep, Ofsted framework, and moderation tools
- [Health & Wellbeing](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/health-wellbeing): Mental health and wellbeing resources, lesson plans, and CPD for primary schools
- [SEND Support](https://www.teachwire.net/primary/send): SEND resources, inclusive lesson planning, SENCO support, and classroom inclusion strategies

## News, EdTech & Professional Development

- [Education News Archive](https://www.teachwire.net/news): Latest UK education news and teaching ideas for primary and secondary schools
- [EdTech Solutions](https://www.teachwire.net/edtech): Educational technology solutions, tools, and cybersecurity guidance for schools

## Subscriptions & Support

- [Subscribe](https://www.teachwire.net/subscribe): Subscription page for Teach Primary, Teach Secondary, and The Headteacher magazines
- [Help & Support](https://www.teachwire.net/contact-us): Help, support, FAQs, account login, and content contribution information
